title.value: Research Scholarships Round 2 (April and July 2027 intakes)
title.evidence_quote: Round 2 applications open 2 November and close 5 February 2027 for April and July 2027 intakes

field: All research fields (higher degree by research)
qualifications: International applicants: Griffith International Pathway, i.e. completed or completing an Honours, Masters or Graduate Diploma at Griffith University with a minimum 40 credit point research component in the last ten years
Domestic applicants: open merit round including the Research Training Program and the Griffith University Postgraduate Research Scholarship
description_short: Griffith University's Round 2 research scholarships, for April and July 2027 higher degree by research intakes, opened on 2 November 2026 and close on 5 February 2027. International applicants in this round need a qualifying research-component degree from Griffith.
